description_en: Queries the configuration of a common switch
name: GetCommonSwitchConfig

parameters.help_en:
The type of the common switch.

You can call the [ListClientUserDefineRules](~~ListClientUserDefineRules~~) or [ListSystemClientRules](~~ListSystemClientRules~~) operation to obtain the switch type from the response parameter SwitchId
parameters.help_zh:
通用开关类型。
通过[ListClientUserDefineRules](~~ListClientUserDefineRules~~)、[ListSystemClientRules](~~ListSystemClientRules~~)接口的响应参数SwitchId可以获取该参数
parameters.name: type

TargetDefault.description_en:
Specifies whether to turn on the switch for newly added servers. Valid values:

add: By default, the switch is turned on for newly added servers.
del: By default, the switch is turned off for newly added servers
TargetDefault.description_zh:
默认是否生效。取值：

add：新增主机默认生效。
del：新增主机默认不生效

TargetSyncStatus.description_en:
The status of the synchronization. Valid values:

sync: The modifications are being synchronized.
valid: The modifications has taken effect
TargetSyncStatus.description_zh:
同步状态。取值：

sync：修改正在同步。
valid：修改已生效

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
